title: Luna 9 landing site (Moon)

place.label: Oceanus Procellarum, the Moon
place.basis: Coordinates as printed in NSSDCA's Luna table; the table gives no reference frame

measures.label: Latitude and longitude on the Moon

facts.text: NSSDCA's Luna table lists Luna 9: launched 31 January 1966, landed 3 February 1966 at 18:44:52 UT, 7.08 N, 295.63 E, Oceanus Procellarum.

tiers.everyday: Luna 9 landed on the Moon on 3 February 1966 in Oceanus Procellarum. NASA lists the site at 7.08 N, 295.63 E on the Moon.
tiers.student: NSSDCA's Luna table lists Luna 9 as launched on 31 January 1966 and landed on 3 February 1966 at 18:44:52 UT, in Oceanus Procellarum, at 7.08 N, 295.63 E. The launch site is not on that page [UNKNOWN].

unknowns: Luna 9 launch site: not on the NSSDCA page, so [UNKNOWN]
